paite: Tapa pil in apa hilhna aza a; himahleh musitmi in asalhna aza kei hi.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

paite: Mi'n akam gah in hoih ane ding hi; himahleh lepchiahmi kha in hiamgamna ane ding hi.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

paite: Kuapeuh akam veng in ahinna avom a; himahleh kuapeuh amukte hong za in siatna anei ding hi.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

paite: Thadah kha in adeih a, bangmah anei kei; himahleh thanuam kha thausak in a-om ding hi.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

paite: Midiktat in zuau ahua; himahleh migilou huathuai ahi a, zumna atung sek hi.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

paite: Lampi a mitang amah diktatna in aveng; himahleh gitlouhna in mikhial aman hi.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

paite: Amah leh amah hausa a kibawl a-om, himahleh bangmah anei kei; amah-le-amah genthei a kibawl a-om, himahleh hauhsakna thupi anei hi.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

paite: Mihing hinna tat man ahauhsakna ahi; himahleh genthei in vaulauna aza kei hi.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

paite: Midiktat vakna akipak a; himahleh migilou khawnvak akithat ding.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

paite: Kisaktheih ziak in kiselna kia ahong a; himahleh hoihtak a thuhilh pilna ahi.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

paite: Bangmah lou a hauhsakna muh akiam ding; himahleh sepgimna ziak a lakkhawm apung ding hi.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

paite: Lametna halsawt in lungtang achinasak a; himahleh deih ahong tun chiang in, hinna sing ahi.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

paite: Kuapeuh thu musit in atung ah asiatna atun hi; himahleh kuapeuh thupiak kihta kipahman piak in a-om ding.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

paite: Mipil dan hinna tuikhuk ahi, sihna thangte a kipan a paimangna ding.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

paite: Theihsiamna hoih in deihsakna apia a; himahleh lepchiahmi lampi aphok hi.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

paite: Mipilvang peuhmah in theihna toh in nna asem a; himahleh mihai in diklouhna athehzak.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

paite: Sawltak gilou hoih lou ah apuk a; himahleh palai muanhuai damna ahi.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

paite: Gentheihna leh zumna bawlhoihna nial kiang ah a-om dia; himahleh salhna limsak zahtak in a-om ding.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

paite: Deih hihpichin kha a ding in anuam a; himahleh gilou a kipan paimang mihaite a ding in kihhuai ahi.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

paite: Mipilte toh ton in, huchi in na pil ding; himahleh mihaite kithuahpih in huaiziak in athuak ding.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

paite: Hoih lou in mikhialte adelh a; himahleh midiktat hoih a thuk in a-om ding hi.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

paite: Mihoih in gouluah ata leh tute kiang ah anutsiat; mikhial hauhsakna midiktat a dia kholkhawm in a-om hi.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

paite: Genthei loukhohna ah an tampi a-om; himahleh diklouhna ziak a suksiat a-om hi.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

paite: Kuapeuh chiang zang lou in atapa amudah a; himahleh amah it in amah thanuamtak in asawi zel hi.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

paite: Midiktat in akha lungkimna tan in ane a; himahleh migilou gilpi atasam ding.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.
